title: the This computer page of Settings names the computer and the computer

clauses.text: the This computer page of Settings names the computer and the computers this install has seen (read only)

steps.do: Open Settings, This computer. Read the label, the boot counts and the category switches, then press Reset this computer and answer No.
steps.expect: The page reads clearly at this screen size and nothing is reset after No.
steps.runner_did: Checked the page text first (when run through the runner)
